summary.method: greedy search (one unit per step, re-relaxed within 7 Å, at most 12 removals)
summary.ensemble: every relaxed configuration evaluated by the search

training_frames.note: kept the existing detach_relax.extxyz (all relaxations cached)

map.model: ladder states (down and up) with the configurational entropy k_B ln C(x, y) of each
map.bounds: k_mean: S_conf = k_B ln C(x, y) of every state (upper bound); k_mean_no_conf: S_conf = 0

configurational.model: k_B ln C(x, y): y ligands X on the x distinct anion-lattice sites next to the surface metals (terminal or bridging, as the builder places X)
